## A note around code

When we come to code, we primarily role out with `R` and `Python`. 

And how about if we inserted some code content, let us go for it——

::: {#fb051254 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
gulu = "333 km from Kampala"
valladolid = "200 km from Madrid"
mombasa = "500 km from Nairobi"
```
:::


The above is `Python` code. 

And R code would look like this instead——

```R
gulu <- "333 km from Kampala"
valladolid <- "200 km from Madrid"
mombasa <- "500 km from Nairobi"
```

And you may notice, the two have different syntax. Yeah!
